Half the base is $5$ cm, so $\cos\theta=\dfrac{5}{8}$.

$\theta=\cos^{-1}\left(\dfrac{5}{8}\right)=51^\circ 19'$

Answer (C).

$\dfrac{\sin\theta}{47}=\dfrac{\sin 30^\circ}{25}$

$\sin\theta=\dfrac{47\sin 30^\circ}{25}$

$\theta=\sin^{-1}\left(\dfrac{47\sin 30^\circ}{25}\right)=70^\circ$

Then the obtuse angle is $180^\circ-70^\circ=110^\circ$. Answer (C).

$\cos\angle PAB=\dfrac{6^2+9.03^2-10^2}{2\times 6\times 9.03}$

$\angle PAB=\cos^{-1}\left(\dfrac{6^2+9.03^2-10^2}{2\times 6\times 9.03}\right)=80^\circ 41'3.08''$

$80^\circ 41'-40^\circ=40^\circ 41'$

$180^\circ-40^\circ 41'=139^\circ 19'$

$\therefore$ the true bearing of Bernie from Angus is $139^\circ 19'$.

\exfigure{713_q13_s1}

Label $L$ (top of lighthouse), $G$ (base), $X$ (on the horizontal through $L$), $B$ and $S$, with $\angle LBG=19^\circ$, $\angle LSB=10^\circ$, $BS=119$ m, and the alternate angle $\angle XLS=10^\circ$.

\exfigure{713_q14_s1}

$\angle LBS=180^\circ-19^\circ=161^\circ$ (supplementary angles)

$\angle XLS=\angle LSB=10^\circ$ (alternate angles, parallel lines)

$\angle SLB=180^\circ-(161^\circ+10^\circ)=9^\circ$ (angle sum of a triangle)

$\dfrac{LB}{\sin 10^\circ}=\dfrac{BS}{\sin 9^\circ}$

$LB=\dfrac{119\sin 10^\circ}{\sin 9^\circ}=132.09$

$\sin 19^\circ=\dfrac{LG}{132.09}$

$LG=132.09\sin 19^\circ=43$ m

$\therefore$ the height of the lighthouse is 43 m.
